text_markup: The Runner uses {card:Singularity} to simultaneously trash a rezzed {card:Hostile Infrastructure} and 2 upgrades. Those cards are moved to Archives and become inactive, but {card:Hostile Infrastructure}'s ability remains active, and 3 instances will become pending, each doing 1 net damage when it resolves. Once all those instances are resolved, {card:Hostile Infrastructure}'s ability stops being active.
